scope: Explicit engine-profile readiness and price observations; not full Trex qualification or trade execution

clauses.rule: Freeze explicit candidate, levels, target identifiers, supplied evidence, structure roles and parameters. No automatic level discovery or retargeting. Only append new same-identity closed bars and advance the selection cursor to the last usable entry bar.

Readiness requires real analyzer strict confirmation, origin-known context, source-linked pivot review, consistent level/target, ready structure, consistent structural target and clear direct path. Shape-only confirmation, unknown evidence or already-ready initial state must not create a new activation.

Evaluate once per available-information group. Never backdate activation to the confirmation candle when higher-frame or entry data arrived later. Preserve delayed rows so the core parser blocks the entire unavailable tail. Later prices or missing horizon tails must not alter earlier snapshots.

Historical replay uses declared archive availability and remains retrospective. Prospective recording requires declared observed receipts and complete local publication before the next entry candle close; that candle may already be open. Partial candle prices are excluded. Local timestamps are not trusted third-party notarization.

Keep occurrence, availability and observation times separate. Readiness observed after the fixed price horizon does not become within-horizon activation. Target price observations do not imply an entry, fill, stop execution or profit.

Invalid future duration, alignment, OHLC or price-grid values must be rejected. Missing future entry bars prevent final settlement; unsupported or insufficient analysis remains explicit. Completed scenarios cannot revive: later touches are post-termination observations with no active scenario credit.

Decision, publication receipt and outcome are non-replacing files. Verification recomputes using the same engine files/contracts; when they differ, use the original version rather than claim the old record was verified by new rules.
